policy.promotion: Both scores must be strictly below the last accepted run.
policy.failed_run: Both scores increased versus the immediately preceding measured run.
policy.scope: Performance aggregates only; correctness and frozen-source qualification are separate prerequisites.
policy.holdout_use: Aggregate acceptance after training-only selection and freeze; no per-case holdout tuning.
policy.controls: Report raw Mech runtime, original-reference drift and C drift separately; this gate uses the fixed Mech/C metric.

interpretation: Strictly compare both frozen scores with accepted31. All measurements and regressions remain. No tolerance or post-hoc exclusion.
